title: Sevin's Stasis Spells Shop
description: A nighttime street scene featuring the curved blue facade of Sevin's Stasis Spells, Locked & Fused shop. An elderly woman in a dark hooded cloak stands at the open blue door, holding a bundle of dried herbs, with white smoke rising from a small cauldron at her feet.
